title: Volvo FH16 Hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar #11
description: Volvo FH16 Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts and indicator repeaters mounted in external box uprights. Flip over Road Train sign on aluminium plate. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin which is accessible when Road Train sign is removed.
